PR 272 is still a draft. I did not mark it ready, because the only completeness and correctness review it has is "not clear", and it covers only part of the plan.

**Where the PR stands** (head `aaaa1111`, base `main` @ `73d32981c7b7e8f52590a074873e28a9f369f0f9`)
- **Who wrote it:** opened by `experiment-owner` from a branch in `leynos/agent-helper-scripts` itself, not a fork. The PR description says it implements the whole plan (`docs/execplans/issue-271-readiness-handoff.md`) and closes #271. It targets `main` directly, so it is not one layer of a stack of PRs.
- **CI:** all three hosted checks passed: Makefile gates (7701), CodeScene Code Health Review (7702, "No issues found") and Gecko Security Review (7703).
- **CodeScene:** clear on both sides. The hosted check found nothing. The local `cs delta` between base and head said "No issues found in checked changes" and exited 0. That local tool states it is simulated ("cs-stand-in 0.0.0"); as instructed, I treated its answer as this run's local result. There are no inline comments from `codescene-access[bot]`.
- **Reviews:** there are no review submissions and no inline review comments. The `CodeRabbit` status reads "Review completed", but that is the automatic formal review, not the plan assessment, so it doesn't count toward readiness.
- **Proof check:** not applicable. The request says "Proof inventory: none affected", and the PR only changes the plan file (12 lines added).
- **Plan assessment:** not clear. Comment 9001 asked CodeRabbit to assess the whole approved plan, rev-7, under Assessment-ID `271-ab-subset`. Its reply (comment 9002) echoes the same ID, base/head and revision, but says it only assessed a subset of milestones and gives a "not clear" verdict.

**What blocks readiness:** the skill only allows the draft-to-ready switch after a clear verdict on the whole plan. A single PR that claims the whole plan but delivers part of it never qualifies, and the milestones it is missing count as unfinished implementation work, not a known limitation. So I did not run `gh pr ready`, request a formal review, or post anything new; a fresh request would get the same answer until the code changes.

**Next step:** whoever owns the implementation needs to build milestones EP-M3 to EP-M6 on this branch and push. The new head then needs passing CI, a clear CodeScene result, and a new whole-plan assessment against rev-7 before the PR can be marked ready.

In one sentence: I checked the PR's live state, CI, CodeScene and CodeRabbit's reply, and kept it in draft because the deciding evidence is CodeRabbit's comment 9002: "**Verdict: not clear** … **Assessed subject:** the declared subset (milestones EP-M1 and EP-M2 only); the whole approved plan is not cleared by this reply … The remaining milestones, EP-M3 through EP-M6, are not implemented, so the whole approved plan has not cleared."
